messages:
Priya (docs): Quick FYI - doing a sweep of the Dedicated provisioning docs. Found a few inconsistent example fields, a dangling anchor, and an old SDK snippet still using ClientV1. Planning a single PR to: normalize fields, add a migration table, fix the anchor + redirect, and include minimal smoke examples. Thoughts?

doc-lint-bot: Scan summary: 3 deprecated tokens, 1 broken anchor (#isolation-decorators-old), 1 snippet using ClientV1. Full: https://ci.internal/doc-scans/5070001111 :robot_face:

Ethan (eng-runtime): Thanks Priya. We migrated to v2 naming a while back. Recommend standardizing on these keys: scalePolicy, reserved_capacity, isolation_labels. Also include a one-liner about min_instances vs warm cache.

Priya (docs): Agreed. Draft one-liner for cache: "Note: scaling to 0 drops in-memory KV caches; set min_instances >= 1 to keep caches warm." Short and explicit.

Noelle (infra): Old anchor is from the handbook split; I'll add a redirect entry in infra-docs. Give me the exact new anchor name and I'll reference your docs PR.

Priya (docs): New anchor name is #isolation-decorators (no "-old"). I'll update the include refs.

Carlos (product): Can we add a compact SLA note about provisioning timing? Users often ask if reserved_capacity changes are instant. A short line like "reservations typically provision within 2-5 minutes; during peak may take up to 10 minutes" should suffice.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Good call. Also add a short clarification: "If reserved_capacity > current active instances, system will warm to the requested number transparently; billing applies immediately."

Priya (docs): Draft migration table (one-liners):
- ClientV1 -> ProvisioningClient (v2)
- autoscale -> scalePolicy
- reserved_pool -> reserved_capacity
- isolation-labels-old -> isolation_labels

Priya (docs): Minimal autoscale YAML (examples/autoscale/minimal-staging.yaml):
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization_pct: 70
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 6
```

Priya (docs): Python v2 snippet (short):
```python
# redwood-sdk v2
from redwood import ProvisioningClient
client = ProvisioningClient()
policy = {"scalePolicy": {"mode": "target_utilization", "target_utilization_pct": 70}}
client.tenants.update_scale("$TENANT_ID", policy)
```

Ethan (eng-runtime): Looks good. Small nit: method name should be `update_scale` (snake_case) as shown. Add a short comment about replacing $TENANT_ID and using env var for creds.

Priya (docs): Added comment and removed hardcoded keys. TS one-liner for quick copy: `await client.tenants.updateScale($TENANT_ID, policy)`

Noelle (infra): Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-docs/pull/1102. I linked the old anchor and pointed to #isolation-decorators. Will add a 301 meta and update includes.

Carlos (product): Also add a tiny clarifying sentence under Isolation: "Use isolation_labels to ensure tenant workloads are placed on labeled pools; mislabeling can result in eviction." Short and clear.

Priya (docs): Added that line. Also adding a short example showing min_instances vs reserved_capacity interplay:
"If reserved_capacity is 3 and scalePolicy.min_instances is 1, reserved_capacity will ensure 3 warm instances are kept. To guarantee warm capacity, set min_instances >= reserved_capacity."

Ethan (eng-runtime): Can you include a CLI apply command for operators? `rwctl tenants set-scale --tenant $TENANT_ID --file autoscale.yaml` would be handy in the example.

Priya (docs): Done. Also added a tiny production recommendation: "For production, consider target_utilization_pct 65-75 depending on p95 latency budget."

doc-lint-bot: Scheduled re-scan after linked PRs merge to verify no legacy tokens remain.

Priya (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5108 - updates examples, migration table, anchor fixes, SDK snippets, CLI examples, and a 1-line SLA note. Assigning @Ethan for runtime blurb and @Noelle for infra redirect pairing.

Ethan (eng-runtime): I'll add a one-paragraph runtime compatibility blurb in the PR comments.

Noelle (infra): Linking redirect PR in your PR now.

Carlos (product): I'll schedule a quick staging smoke after merge: apply minimal-staging.yaml to a staging tenant and confirm instances warm within expected time.

Priya (docs): Thanks all. Will merge after Ethan's blurb and a quick review. Closing thread after merge + re-scan.
